name: claude-md
description: CLAUDE.md — the note Claude reads first: the four Karpathy rules, your real ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.claude/rules/*.md read live as the load order, and a one-click install that gives the rules their own rule file.

atelier.note: Reads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.claude/rules/*.md live. The install action, only with explicit confirmation, writes the four rules to ~/.claude/rules/instructions.md; if a CLAUDE.md chapter already carries them, that chapter is moved over verbatim and CLAUDE.md is rewritten without it. Both files are backed up first.
